builds.name: Reference: Range and poke
builds.goal: Reference for Zoe: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged pick mage who uses terrain-extended sleep and long-travel Q for burst, then returns from a brief portal. Spell shards offer opportunistic movement and damage rather than a guaranteed loadout. Fix Q travel distance, Sleep state and the spell shard actually available. Lich Bane needs a real attack; Portal returns to a known point and cannot be treated as a permanent escape. Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment.
testPlan: Kit question for Zoe: Fix Q travel distance, Sleep state and the spell shard actually available. Lich Bane needs a real attack; Portal returns to a known point and cannot be treated as a permanent escape.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Horizon) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Comet can miss and distance matters; no automatic full-range damage bonus.

The route fails Zoe's stated kit question: Fix Q travel distance, Sleep state and the spell shard actually available. Lich Bane needs a real attack; Portal returns to a known point and cannot be treated as a permanent escape.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Comet can miss and distance matters; no automatic full-range damage bonus.
Full cost 16,050 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Luden, then Horizon. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zoe dropkicks a bubble that deals [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage, lingering as a trap if it hits nothing. The bubble's range is extended when flying over terrain.

If either the bubble or trap hits an enemy champion she refreshes [(0.16 / 0.195 / 0.23 / 0.265 / 0.3) × 100]% of her cooldown.

After a delay, the victim falls Asleep and have their Magic Resist reduced by [30]% for 2 seconds. Attacks and Ability hits wake them up but deal double damage, up to [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.45) × AP] true damage.

Passive: Enemies drop spell shards when casting a Summoner Spell or using an Active Item. Specific minions also drop a spell shard when Zoe or a nearby ally kills them. Zoe can pick up this shard to cast that ability once.

Passive: When Zoe casts this Ability or any Summoner Spell, she gains [(0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7) × 100]% Move Speed for [2 / 2.25 / 2.5 / 2.75 / 3] seconds and tosses 3 missiles at the target she Attacked most recently. These missiles deal [15 / 25 / 35 / 45 / 55 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage each.

Active: Cast the Ability from a spell shard Zoe has picked up.

Zoe fires a star that deals increasing damage the further it travels to the first enemy hit and surrounding enemies -- between [50 / 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 14, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × AP] to [(50 / 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 14, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × AP) × (2.5)] magic damage.

Zoe can Recast this Ability to redirect the missile to a new position near Zoe.

After using an Ability, Zoe's next Attack deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=16, perLevel=4, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 8.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage.
Zoe teleports to a nearby position for 1 second. Afterwards, she teleports back. Zoe can use Abilities and Attack, but can't move during this time.
